levels.title: Hello app
levels.goal: Wire a complete minimal Shiny app in Python.
levels.body:
Every Shiny for Python app is `App(ui, server)`.
UI is a layout. Server is a function of (input, output, session).
Keep the ids stable — they are the graph endpoints.
levels.hint: Need App(, input_slider, output_text, render.text, and def server.
levels.starterCode:
from shiny import App, ui, render

app_ui = ui.page_sidebar(
    ui.sidebar(
        # add an input_text with id "n"
    ),
    # add output_text("greeting")
)

def server(input, output, session):
    # render greeting
    pass

app = App(app_ui, server)

levels.title: Slider drives text
levels.goal: Read a slider and print a formatted result.
levels.body:
Inputs are callable: `input.x()`.
Outputs are functions decorated with `@render.*` and registered with `@output`.
levels.hint: input_slider("x", ...) and @render.text that returns a string using input.x().
levels.starterCode:
from shiny import App, ui, render

app_ui = ui.page_sidebar(
    ui.sidebar(
        ui.input_slider("x", "X", 0, 100, 10),
    ),
    ui.output_text("out"),
)

def server(input, output, session):
    # make out report the square of x
    pass

app = App(app_ui, server)

levels.title: Share work with a reactive
levels.goal: Put the math in `@reactive.calc` and use it from two outputs.
levels.body:
`@reactive.calc` caches until inputs change.
Both outputs read the same node — no duplicated formula.
levels.hint: Define `def y():` with `@reactive.calc`, then use y() in both renders.

levels.title: Commit on button press
levels.goal: Use eventReactive so text updates only when the button is pressed.
levels.body:
Sliders fire on every move. Actions should wait for a click.
`@reactive.event(input.go)` freezes the dependency edge until the event fires.
levels.hint: @reactive.event(input.go) on a calc that reads input.x().

levels.title: Guard with req
levels.goal: Stop output errors when the text input is empty.
levels.body:
`req(...)` raises a silent cancel when its arguments are falsy.
Use it at the top of an output instead of nested if-statements.
